Class View<T extends Controller>

java.lang.Object
views.View<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of controller associated with this view
Direct Known Subclasses:
AddBugemonView, DefeatView, FightView, ItemsView, LevelUpView, PreBuildTeamView, RewardView, SelectAttackView, SelectBugemonFromTeamView, SelectionView, TitleScreenView, VictoryView
public abstract class View<T extends Controller> extends Object
Abstract base class for all views. Loads an FXML file, sets itself as the controller, and wraps the result in a Scene.

Popup logic is delegated to a PopupManager instance. Subclasses can call the convenience methods directly, or access popup for finer control. PopupManager is user by View and SubView classes.

    • attachTo

      public void attachTo(javafx.stage.Stage stage)
      Attaches this view's scene and title to the given stage without showing it.

      This method is mainly used by the meta-controller when opening sub-scenes in secondary windows.

      Parameters:
      stage - the stage to configure with this view

    • closeWindow
